soru: Robot öğrenmesine fizik önbilgilerinin (fiziksel yasalar, simetriler, dinamik modeller) katılması üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Robot öğrenmesine fizik önbilgilerinin (fiziksel yasalar, simetriler, dinamik modeller) katılması üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-08-15. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Deep Lagrangian Networks: Using Physics as Model Prior for Deep Learning
calismalar.gerekce: DeLaN builds the Euler-Lagrange equations into the network itself, and it was the first deep model to use this kind of physics prior for real-time robot tracking control.

calismalar.baslik: Hamiltonian Neural Networks
calismalar.gerekce: It learns the Hamiltonian directly, which gives energy-conserving dynamics models and set off the whole line of work on physics-structured networks.

calismalar.baslik: Physics-informed neural networks: A deep learning framework for solving forward and inverse problems involving nonlinear partial differential equations
calismalar.gerekce: This is the founding PINN paper; it adds physical laws to training as residual terms in the loss.

calismalar.baslik: Physics-informed machine learning
calismalar.gerekce: A widely cited review that sets out how physics priors can enter through data, architecture and loss, and lists the field's open problems.

calismalar.baslik: Lagrangian Neural Networks
calismalar.gerekce: It learns arbitrary Lagrangians without needing canonical coordinates, which broadens energy-conserving dynamics learning.

calismalar.baslik: Interaction Networks for Learning about Objects, Relations and Physics
calismalar.gerekce: The first general-purpose learnable physics engine that uses objects and relations as an inductive bias.

calismalar.baslik: Graph Networks as Learnable Physics Engines for Inference and Control
calismalar.gerekce: It uses graph-structured physics models for system identification and for gradient-based control and planning of robot bodies.

calismalar.baslik: Learning to Simulate Complex Physics with Graph Networks
calismalar.gerekce: GNS learns simulators for fluids, rigid bodies and deformable materials, and it generalizes to long horizons and much larger systems.

calismalar.baslik: End-to-End Differentiable Physics for Learning and Control
calismalar.gerekce: A differentiable rigid-body engine built on an LCP formulation that sits inside a network and supports parameter learning and control.

calismalar.baslik: TossingBot: Learning to Throw Arbitrary Objects with Residual Physics
calismalar.gerekce: It made the 'residual physics' idea well known by learning a correction on top of an analytical projectile model.

calismalar.baslik: Combining Physics and Deep Learning to learn Continuous-Time Dynamics Models
calismalar.gerekce: A thorough IJRR study comparing Lagrangian and Hamiltonian networks against black-box models on real robots.

calismalar.baslik: Neural Lander: Stable Drone Landing Control using Learned Dynamics
calismalar.gerekce: It pairs a nominal physics model with a spectrally normalized learned residual and gives a stability guarantee.

calismalar.baslik: Neural-Fly Enables Rapid Learning for Agile Flight in Strong Winds
calismalar.gerekce: It combines a meta-learned aerodynamic representation with physics-based adaptive control and has an exponential stability guarantee.

calismalar.baslik: Symplectic ODE-Net: Learning Hamiltonian Dynamics with Control
calismalar.gerekce: It extends Hamiltonian structure to controlled systems, making energy-shaping control possible with learned models.

calismalar.baslik: Learning Particle Dynamics for Manipulating Rigid Bodies, Deformable Objects, and Fluids
calismalar.gerekce: DPI-Nets use particle-based physics representations for manipulating deformable materials and fluids.

calismalar.baslik: Augmenting Physical Simulators with Stochastic Neural Networks: Case Study of Planar Pushing and Bouncing
calismalar.gerekce: It learns stochastic residuals on top of an analytical simulator, an early and influential hybrid model for contact-rich manipulation.

calismalar.baslik: Simplifying Hamiltonian and Lagrangian Neural Networks via Explicit Constraints
calismalar.gerekce: It handles constraints explicitly in Cartesian coordinates and reports about 100x gains in accuracy and data efficiency.

calismalar.baslik: Neural Descriptor Fields: SE(3)-Equivariant Object Representations for Manipulation
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that SE(3) symmetry allows manipulation to be learned from 5 to 10 demonstrations.

calismalar.baslik: SO(2)-Equivariant Reinforcement Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It builds rotational symmetry into equivariant DQN and SAC and gets large sample-efficiency gains in robot RL.

calismalar.baslik: Equivariant Diffusion Policy
calismalar.gerekce: It adds SO(2) symmetry to diffusion-based imitation policies for full 6-DoF control.

calismalar.baslik: ContactNets: Learning Discontinuous Contact Dynamics with Smooth, Implicit Representations
calismalar.gerekce: It learns non-smooth contact dynamics using complementarity and maximum-dissipation principles as the prior.

calismalar.baslik: Differentiable Physics Models for Real-world Offline Model-based Reinforcement Learning
calismalar.gerekce: On a real robot, it shows that physics-based models beat black-box networks in offline MBRL.

calismalar.baslik: DiffTaichi: Differentiable Programming for Physical Simulation
calismalar.gerekce: A high-performance differentiable simulation language behind gradient-based control and design of soft robots.

calismalar.baslik: Brax - A Differentiable Physics Engine for Large Scale Rigid Body Simulation
calismalar.gerekce: A JAX-based, accelerator-parallel differentiable physics engine that made large-scale robot learning practical.

calismalar.baslik: gradSim: Differentiable simulation for system identification and visuomotor control
calismalar.gerekce: It combines differentiable physics and rendering to estimate physical parameters directly from video.

calismalar.baslik: NeuralSim: Augmenting Differentiable Simulators with Neural Networks
calismalar.gerekce: It augments a differentiable rigid-body simulator with neural networks to learn the unmodeled effects behind the sim-to-real gap.

calismalar.baslik: Combining Physical Simulators and Object-Based Networks for Control
calismalar.gerekce: SAIN combines a physics engine with an object-based network, giving a hybrid model that is data-efficient and generalizes.

calismalar.baslik: A Differentiable Physics Engine for Deep Learning in Robotics
calismalar.gerekce: An early demonstration of training robot controllers by gradients through a differentiable physics engine.

calismalar.baslik: Learning Stable Deep Dynamics Models
calismalar.gerekce: It learns a Lyapunov function together with the dynamics, guaranteeing that the learned model is stable.

calismalar.baslik: Physics-informed Neural Networks to Model and Control Robots: a Theoretical and Experimental Investigation
calismalar.gerekce: It extends PINNs to non-conservative robot dynamics and gives stability bounds for model-based control, tested on a soft robot and a Franka arm.
